reviewNotes: Reviewed all 140 speech keys against all 20 cards and explicit furigana in data/pages36.json. Corrected exporter artifacts 本みりん to ほんみりん and ショしょとう to しょとう. Percentage-only 0% choice preserved as a distinct lookup key and read ぜろぱーせんと; all other percentages read explicitly. Contextual topic/contrast は, には and では rendered わ; object を rendered お; directional へ rendered え for 糖へ, などへ, 中へ, 食材へ, 表面へ and quoted question への. Preserved lexical はたらく, はこぶ, はいり, はやい, はんのう, はっこう and きはつ. Checked もちごめ, しょうちゅう, じゅくせいこう, こうきせいぶん, しゅうきせいぶん, きんせんい, とうそせい, にきり and かんみりょう against source readings. Loanwords rendered in hiragana retaining long-vowel marks. Display text unchanged. No listening or pitch-accent verification.
